description: This file defines an asynchronous execution utility with retry logic, including configurable backoff strategies, for use within the Orleans framework. It provides methods to execute functions repeatedly until success or retry limits are reached, with support for both error and success-based retries.

classes.name: IBackoffProvider
classes.description: Interface for defining backoff strategies which determine delay durations between retries.

classes.name: FixedBackoff
classes.description: Implementation of IBackoffProvider that returns a fixed delay for each retry attempt.

classes.name: ExponentialBackoff
classes.description: Implementation of IBackoffProvider that increases delay exponentially, up to a maximum limit.

methods.name: ExecuteWithRetries
methods.description: Executes a function with specified retry policies, including max retries and backoff strategies. Supports both void and return-value functions.
